clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore’s northern shore, Beached Sea Turtle remains untouched by nearby Greymist murlocs. A sample is carried to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon. Naturalists and priestesses seek to learn why great sea creatures wash ashore and scavengers leave them alone.

Greymist murlocs crowd Darkshore’s northern coast and scavenge whatever food washes up from the Veiled Sea. Yet the great turtle’s skeleton lies mostly untouched. Those studying the shore wonder whether the murlocs missed it or avoided it for some unknown reason.

In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers samples from beached sea turtles for the Temple of the Moon. The night elf priestesses study the disturbances in Darkshore’s waters. Skeletal fragments may help them learn whether sickness, magic, or dangerous sea predators are killing the ancient creatures.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The skeletal remains of a sea turtle lie in the sand of the northern Darkshore beaches. The Greymist murlocs have either not found this carcass, or perhaps they have and are shying away from it for some unknown reason. Regardless, there is enough of the turtle left to take a sample back to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon to study.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello once again friend - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is interesting that the murlocs were not present at this site; we will keep this in mind as we study this creature's remains! Thank you for your effort, friend; the Temple of the Moon would like for me to give you this, as compensation for your time.
